title: NOT AS ADVERTISED! NOT XL!
text: NOT AS ADVERTISED! NOT XL!. This set advertises in every portion of the description as EXTRA LARGE.  It is NOT!  It is a regular sized set of cutting boards and I will have to find a true extra large cutting board.  Even the packaging itself says LARGE, not extra large.  BTW, they are not extra think either!  I detest false advertising and the ONLY reason I', giving it 2 stars is it actually has handles!  Just want to make sure everyone knows these are not what they purport to be!

product_metadata.title: Kikcoin Extra Large Cutting Boards, Plastic Cutting Board for Kitchen Dishwasher Chopping Board Set of 3 with Juice Grooves, Easy Grip Handle
features: 【High-Density 】Our kitchen cutting board set are made from high-density plastic materials, which are thicker and heavier than ordinary cutting boards. After high temperature pressurization, the cutting boards are harder than others. It won't dull knives when chopped, nor will it split or crack.

【No Mess When Cutting】 Built-in juice groove can effectively catch meat, fruit, or vegetable juice from overflowing the groove. Thus you can keep your work area beautiful even during busy cooking time.

【TPE Edging】Both sides of the cutting board are covered by TPE, which has strong adsorption force and can be fixed on smooth surfaces. It‘s not afraid of slipping when cutting food. Each cutting board is equipped with a hanging handle for easy storage.

【Meet All Kitchen Needs】Kikcoin extra large cutting board set includes 3 cutting boards of various sizes: a extra large size (17.33*12.01*0.4 inch) suitable for meat or steak; a large size (13.98*9.65 *0.36 inch) suitable for vegetables; a medium size (11.3*7.68*0.36 inch) suitable for fruit. Various sizes of boards can be used for different ingredients.

This chopping board set arrive ready for use out of the box and it's can be a great gift idea for Thanksgiving, Mother's Day, Father's Day, birthday, anniversary, housewarming ceremony or any occasion.
